title: Repurposing of lansoprazole and nitazoxanide as NR2F2 inhibitors in the gastric cancer cell line GCIY: computational insights and siRNA-mediated in vitro tests.
authors: Culletta, Giulia; Roomi, Muhammad Sohaib; Caricasulo, Maria Azzurra; Zanetti, Adriana; Terao, Mineko; Paroni, Gabriela; Garattini, Enrico; Tutone, Marco
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算虚拟筛选和siRNA实验，研究药物分子与核受体NR2F2（转录因子）的配体结合及转录活性调控，涉及蛋白-配体互作而非直接蛋白-DNA结合建模，方法上以计算筛选和实验验证为主，对TF-DNA互作课题仅有间接启发。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nuclear receptors (NRs) are a superfamily of ligand-activated transcription factors that mediate the cellular response to hormones, vitamins, and dietary lipids, thus orchestrating numerous physiological processes and influencing multiple disease states. Within this superfamily, NR2Fs, also known as Chicken Ovalbumin Upstream Promoter Transcription Factor (COUP-TF), are a family of nuclear orphan receptors, due to the lack of known endogenous ligands. Among them, NR2F2 transcription factor activities involve regulation of cell differentiation during organogenesis, maintenance of adult tissue homeostasis, and tumorigenesis. To date, only the CIA compounds have been identified as inhibitors of NR2F2 driven transcriptional activity in prostate cancer cell lines, with the IC50 of CIA1 falling in the lower muM range. METHODS: A comprehensive computational analysis has been conducted in order to gain insight into the inhibitory activity of the prototype CIA1 against NR2F2 at a molecular level. We leveraged the outputs of computational analysis to perform a virtual screening campaign to FDA compounds capable of binding to NR2F2. Luciferase reporter assay was used to functionally validate the interaction. RNA interference approaches were used to validate the specificity of NR2F2 activity on cell proliferation. RESULTS: We identified lapatinib, glyburide, nitazoxanide, and lansoprazole as modulators of NR2F2-dependent reporter activity. In the gastric cancer cell line GCIY, lansoprazole and nitazoxanide exert antiproliferative effects that are mitigated by NR2F2 silencing. The convergence between in silico predictions and LBD-dependent reporter modulation supports the interpretation that lapatinib, glyburide, nitazoxanide, and lansoprazole represent bona fide functional interactors of NR2F2. CONCLUSION: Taken together, our data extend current evidence that NR2F2 is a ligandable orphan receptor whose transcriptional output can be pharmacologically tuned. Moreover, our findings provide new chemical tools for probing NR2F2 biology and nominate clinically used molecules as starting points for therapeutic or repurposing strategies targeting NR2F2-dependent programs.
abstract_zh: 背景：核受体（Nuclear receptors, NRs）是一个配体激活的转录因子超家族，介导细胞对激素、维生素和膳食脂质的响应，从而协调众多生理过程并影响多种疾病状态。在该超家族中，NR2Fs，也称为鸡卵清蛋白上游启动子转录因子（COUP-TF），由于缺乏已知的内源性配体，属于核孤儿受体家族。其中，NR2F2转录因子活性涉及器官发生过程中的细胞分化调控、成体组织稳态维持以及肿瘤发生。迄今为止，仅CIA化合物被鉴定为前列腺癌细胞系中NR2F2驱动转录活性的抑制剂，其中CIA1的IC50处于低微摩尔范围。方法：为在分子水平上深入了解原型CIA1对NR2F2的抑制活性，我们进行了全面的计算分析。我们利用计算分析的输出结果，对FDA化合物进行了虚拟筛选，以识别能够结合NR2F2的候选物。使用荧光素酶报告基因实验进行功能验证相互作用。采用RNA干扰方法验证NR2F2活性对细胞增殖的特异性。结果：我们鉴定出拉帕替尼（lapatinib）、格列本脲（glyburide）、硝唑尼特（nitazoxanide）和兰索拉唑（lansoprazole）作为NR2F2依赖性报告基因活性的调节剂。在胃癌细胞系GCIY中，兰索拉唑和硝唑尼特发挥抗增殖作用，这些作用通过NR2F2沉默而减弱。计算机预测与LBD依赖性报告基因调节之间的趋同性支持了拉帕替尼、格列本脲、硝唑尼特和兰索拉唑代表NR2F2真正功能相互作用因子的解释。结论：综合来看，我们的数据扩展了现有证据，表明NR2F2是一个可配体的孤儿受体，其转录输出可通过药理学方式调节。此外，我们的发现为探究NR2F2生物学提供了新的化学工具，并提名临床使用的分子作为靶向NR2F2依赖性程序的治疗或再利用策略的起点。
